title: Auth Control Plane membership list request (v1 wire format)
description: Request body of a versioned read. Names one organization. The route names the operation; the body carries no operation member and no credential. Closed: any other member fails.

schema_version.description: Contract identifier. A reader MUST reject an unrecognised value (G-26: unknown denies).

limit.description: Page size. Absent means 50. A value over 100 (and one under 1) is refused, never clamped, so a caller is never silently given less than it asked for.

cursor.description: The opaque keyset cursor of the previous page's next_cursor: 'k1_' and the base64url (no padding) of the last id that page held. The server returns items whose id sorts after it. A caller never builds or reads one.
